heading: cyGrounds for possession
paragraphs: cyIn some cases, you can make a possession claim without relying on a specific ground. If your claim meets these requirements, you can select that you have no grounds for possession.
cyYou may have already given the defendants notice of your intention to begin possession proceedings.
cyIf you have, you should have written the grounds you’re making your claim under. You should select these grounds here and any extra grounds you’d like to add to your claim, if you need to.
cyMore information about possession grounds (opens in new tab)
